== Description ==

[[Daniel Amor]] (right, olive-green hoodie, glasses), [[Ming Huo]] (front left, grey tee), [[Scott Lingrell]] (back left, white hair, glasses, navy Lincoln Financial pullover), [[Garrett Larson]] (background stream table left, pink cap, beard), and [[Brian Fred]] (background stream table right (back), bald, black tee, black shorts) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
